records.name: MutexaGPT
records.demonstrated_target: Halide methyltransferase mutant libraries and bidomain amylase cold-adaptation variants
records.boundary_conditions: Solvated protein MD; periodic biomolecular conditions do not imply crystalline materials

sources.locator: Implementation §§2.1–2.2; Applications §§3.1–3.2; Figs.3–4; Data and code availability
sources.evidence_paraphrase: LLM planning agents translate enzyme-engineering requests into EnzyHTP workflows, build mutation libraries and execute MD. The two protein studies rank variants using trajectory-derived cavity volume or domain-separation statistics. The linked source repository is EnzyHTP-GPT.
The journal version describes the same platform and two enzyme-engineering demonstrations.

records.limitations: Count the preprint, journal article and EnzyHTP-GPT interface once. Supported QM/MM interfaces and available energy metrics do not establish separately executed E/F/R tasks in the inspected cases. Mutant creation and actual MD support T/D; no TS search is inferred from enzyme catalysis.

records.name: PULSES
records.demonstrated_target: Benzene and perylene monomers/dimers, ethylene excited-state datasets, biphenyl in solvents, HBQ excited-state proton transfer
records.boundary_conditions: Gas-phase molecular calculations and explicit-solvent MD of molecular solutes

sources.evidence_paraphrase: Expert-approved plans are executed by paired domain and scientific-assurance agents. Worked cases construct dimer grids, optimize perylene monomers, compute electronic labels and run molecular dynamics, including reactive HBQ trajectories. Artifacts and their downstream dependencies are checked at successive stages.
The original report was submitted on 23 October 2026.

aliases: Paired agents for Unified Learning and Simulation of Excited States
records.limitations: Explicit-solvent applications remain finite molecular studies under the target taxonomy. Reactive dynamics and a prescribed energy scan are not credited as a stationary-TS/path-search R task. No frequency evidence was independently coded. Human-approved scientific boundaries and artifact assurance are a relevant architectural neighbour; reported success remains task-specific.

screening.reason: Memory-enhanced chemical problem solving, distinct from Yu et al. ChemAgent/ChemToolAgent. Not an executed molecular-simulation demonstration in the inspected evaluation.
